# Vincent Clemson

::: {.reveal .ltr .q1}
> Exploring [complex systems]{.em1} through [**data**]{.em3}, [**software**]{.em3}, and [**storytelling**]{.em3} to make difficult ideas become <em>**possible.**</em>
:::

::: {.statement}
👋 Welcome.

I build analytical systems to understand complex problems. Along the way, that has meant geospatial analysis, mathematical modeling, documentary filmmaking, and increasingly AI evaluation. This is where I document that journey, publishing the work, the experiments, and the lessons learned along the way.
